_note: Per-operator settings (operator_ref, service_day_start_hour, ...) live in operators.json.

gps_end_snap._note: build_day.py SNAP: a GPS end ('ליד …') moves to the planned last stop only when gps_km >= share * km_plan, the last point is <= max_km (air) from the stop and not past it along the route (before_tol_km), and the time to the next trip covers the rest at the line's planned speed; start mirrored (first point within start_share of the route, <= start_max_km). Otherwise marked trunc_end/trunc_start ('קטיעה אפשרית').

gps_heading._note: build_day.py HEAD: an empty leg from/to a raw GPS point ('ליד …') is routed with the SIRI heading of that point as an OSRM bearing (+- tol_deg, snapped within radius_m; 15 m keeps it off a parallel road such as Begin next to Golda Meir; heading 0 = unknown, not used), so it leaves on the bus's carriageway. First the point is moved onto the line's own road (OSRM between the two licensed stops around it, within line_m), and the heading is that road's direction there; when that route has a U-turn/revisit or OSRM has none, the usual routing is used.
